definitionEn: A primitive collection in ZF set theory, whose identity is determined by its members.
definitionZh: ZF 集合论中的基本对象；两个集合相等当且仅当元素完全相同。
distinction: Listing order and repetitions do not change a set; they can change a sequence.

definitionEn: $A$ is a subset of $B$ if $x\in A$ implies $x\in B$ for every $x$.
definitionZh: 若 A 的每个元素均属于 B，则 A 是 B 的子集。
distinction: Use ⊆ inclusively; ⊊ requires inequality. The meaning of ⊂ varies between authors.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §11.1 Elementary Set Theory; §11.4 Cartesian Product and Power Set

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第1章「ZFC 公理一览」

definitionEn: The unique set with no members.
definitionZh: 没有任何元素的唯一集合。
distinction: The empty set has zero elements; the singleton containing it has one.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §11.1 Elementary Set Theory; §11.4 Cartesian Product and Power Set

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第1章「ZFC 公理一览」

definitionEn: The set of every subset of a given set A.
definitionZh: 由给定集合 A 的全部子集组成的集合。
distinction: Members of a power set are subsets, rather than necessarily members, of A.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §11.1 Elementary Set Theory; §11.4 Cartesian Product and Power Set

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第1章「ZFC 公理一览」

definitionEn: For sets A and B, the set of ordered pairs with first coordinate in A and second in B.
definitionZh: 集合 A 与 B 的笛卡尔积是所有第一分量属于 A、第二分量属于 B 的有序对的集合。
distinction: Coordinate order matters. Li calls this 积集; the university syllabus explicitly uses 笛卡尔积.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §11.1 Elementary Set Theory; §11.4 Cartesian Product and Power Set

translationSources.label: 鲍志强（北京大学）— 拓扑学2007年秋季教学纲要

definitionEn: $\forall x\,\varphi$ holds under an assignment in a structure precisely when $\varphi$ holds for every domain value assigned to $x$.
definitionZh: 在给定结构和赋值下，∀x φ 为真当且仅当把 x 赋为论域中的任意元素时 φ 都为真。
distinction: Restricted universal quantification uses implication: ∀x∈A P means ∀x(x∈A→P).

definitionEn: $\exists x\,\varphi$ holds when some domain value for $x$ makes $\varphi$ true under the remaining assignment.
definitionZh: 保持其他变元赋值不变，若论域中至少一个元素作为 x 的值使 φ 为真，则 ∃x φ 为真。
distinction: Existence does not assert uniqueness; ∃! is a different assertion.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §7.2 The Universal Quantifier; §7.3 The Existential Quantifier

definitionEn: A variable is free in a formula if at least one occurrence is outside any quantifier binding that occurrence.
definitionZh: 若变元在公式中至少有一次出现未被相应量词约束，则它是该公式的自由变元。
distinction: Freedom is a property of occurrences first: one variable can have both free and bound occurrences.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §7.2 The Universal Quantifier; §7.3 The Existential Quantifier

translationSources.label: 杨睿之（复旦大学）— 数理逻辑，第15讲
translationSources.locator: PDF p.4 前情提要：「自由变元的语义」

definitionEn: An occurrence of a variable within the scope of a quantifier for that variable, bound by the nearest such quantifier.
definitionZh: 变元在相应量词作用域内、由最近的同名量词约束的一次出现。
example: The second $x$ in $\forall x\;(x=y)$ is bound.
distinction: Renaming must avoid capture; changing a bound name is not the same as changing a free parameter.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §7.2 The Universal Quantifier; §7.3 The Existential Quantifier

translationSources.label: 杨睿之（复旦大学）— 数理逻辑，2021年秋季
translationSources.locator: PDF pp.17–20: 一阶逻辑的语言；自由出现与约束出现

definitionEn: A formula of a first-order language with no free variable occurrences.
definitionZh: 一阶语言中不含自由变元出现的公式。
example: $\forall x\;(x=x)$ is a sentence; $x=x$ is an open formula.
distinction: A sentence may be false in a structure; being closed does not mean being a theorem.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §7.2 The Universal Quantifier; §7.3 The Existential Quantifier

translationSources.label: 杨睿之（复旦大学）— 数理逻辑，2021年秋季
translationSources.locator: PDF p.20：「语句（sentence）」及没有自由出现的定义

definitionEn: An argument deriving the conclusion from the given hypotheses by justified steps, without adopting its negation as the main temporary assumption.
definitionZh: 从已给假设出发，通过有根据的推理得到结论的一种证明方法。
distinction: Proving an implication directly still permits assuming its antecedent; direct does not mean assumption-free.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §3.1 Derivations in Natural Deduction; §3.3 Forward and Backward Reasoning

translationSources.label: 高等教育出版社 — 数学证明 通往高等数学的阶梯（第4版）影印版，官方中文目录
translationSources.locator: 官方中文目录：§3.2 直接证明（名称证据，非正文定义证据）

definitionEn: In classical logic, a proof of $P$ obtained by deriving $\bot$ from the premises together with $\neg P$.
definitionZh: 在经典逻辑中，暂设结论的否定并推出矛盾，从而确立结论的证明方法。
example: A least positive rational $r$ would be contradicted by the smaller positive rational $r/3$.
distinction: For positive conclusions the method uses double-negation elimination; proving a negation from a contradiction is already intuitionistically valid.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §5.1 Proof by Contradiction; §5.2 Some Classical Principles

translationSources.label: 杨睿之（复旦大学）— 数理逻辑，第12讲
translationSources.locator: PDF p.17 推论「反证法」；其形式先证明否定结论

definitionEn: A classical proof of $P\to Q$ by deriving $\neg P$ from $\neg Q$.
definitionZh: 通过证明逆否命题 ¬Q→¬P 来确立原命题 P→Q 的经典证明方法。
example: To show $n^2$ odd implies $n$ odd, show even $n=2k$ has even square $4k^2$.
distinction: The converse Q→P is not the contrapositive; reversing an implication alone is invalid.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §5.1 Proof by Contradiction; §5.2 Some Classical Principles

translationSources.label: 高等教育出版社 — 数学证明 通往高等数学的阶梯（第4版）影印版，官方中文目录
translationSources.locator: 官方中文目录：§3.3 逆否法证明（名称证据，非正文定义证据）

definitionEn: For $P$ on $\mathbb N$, the principle that $P(0)$ and every implication $P(n)\to P(n+1)$ together yield $\forall n\,P(n)$.
definitionZh: 自然数上的证明原理：零处成立且从任意 n 处成立能推出 n+1 处成立，则所有自然数处均成立。
distinction: A successor implication without a true base case proves nothing about all indices.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §17.1 The Principle of Induction; §17.2 Variants of Induction

translationSources.label: 高等教育出版社 — 数学证明 通往高等数学的阶梯（第4版）影印版，官方中文目录
translationSources.locator: 官方中文目录：第6章 数学归纳法；§6.1 数学归纳法原理（名称证据，非正文定义证据）

definitionEn: The principle that proving $P(n)$ from all $P(k)$ with $k<n$, for each $n\in\mathbb N$, proves $P$ everywhere.
definitionZh: 对每个自然数 n，在假设所有 k<n 的情形成立时证明 n 的情形，即可得到全部情形成立的归纳原理。
example: Factorization existence for $n\geq2$: a composite $n=ab$ uses the earlier cases $2\leq a,b<n$.
distinction: The n=0 obligation is not omitted; its earlier-case hypothesis is empty.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §17.1 The Principle of Induction; §17.2 Variants of Induction

translationSources.label: 高等教育出版社 — 数学证明 通往高等数学的阶梯（第4版）影印版，官方中文目录
translationSources.locator: 官方中文目录：§6.3 强数学归纳法原理（名称证据，非正文定义证据）

definitionEn: An admissible instance satisfying a claim’s hypotheses but falsifying its asserted conclusion.
definitionZh: 满足命题的假设而使其结论为假的一个具体实例。
distinction: An input violating the hypotheses is not a counterexample to the conditional theorem.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §7.2 The Universal Quantifier; §7.3 The Existential Quantifier

translationSources.label: 高等教育出版社 — 数学证明 通往高等数学的阶梯（第4版）影印版，官方中文目录
translationSources.locator: 官方中文目录：§5.1 反例（名称证据，非正文定义证据）

definitionEn: The classical connective $P\to Q$, false exactly when $P$ is true and $Q$ is false.
definitionZh: 经典命题联结词 P→Q；它恰在 P 真且 Q 假时为假。
example: $(2=3)\to(5=7)$ is true as a material implication.
distinction: A true implication with false antecedent is not evidence of a causal connection.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §2.4 The Language of Propositional Logic

translationSources.label: 高等教育出版社 — 数学证明 通往高等数学的阶梯（第4版）影印版，官方中文目录
translationSources.locator: 官方中文目录：§2.4 蕴涵（名称证据，非正文定义证据）

definitionEn: Two propositional formulas are logically equivalent when they have equal truth values under every valuation.
definitionZh: 两个命题公式在所有真值赋值下均有相同真值时称逻辑等价。
example: $P\to Q$ is classically equivalent to $\neg P\lor Q$.
distinction: Agreement under one valuation is weaker than logical equivalence.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §2.4 The Language of Propositional Logic

translationSources.label: 高等教育出版社 — 数学证明 通往高等数学的阶梯（第4版）影印版，官方中文目录
translationSources.locator: 官方中文目录：§2.8 逻辑等价（名称证据，非正文定义证据）

definitionEn: The connective producing a statement true exactly when both component statements are true.
definitionZh: 恰在两个分量命题都为真时为真的联结方式。
distinction: Conjunction requires both components; disjunction in this glossary is inclusive.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §2.4 The Language of Propositional Logic

translationSources.label: 高等教育出版社 — 数学证明 通往高等数学的阶梯（第4版）影印版，官方中文目录
translationSources.locator: 官方中文目录：§2.3 析取与合取（名称证据，非正文定义证据）

definitionEn: The inclusive connective producing a statement true when at least one component is true.
definitionZh: 至少一个分量命题为真时即为真的包含式联结方式。
example: $(3<4)\lor(4<8)$ is true even though both components are true.
distinction: Exclusive or imposes an additional prohibition on both components being true.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §2.4 The Language of Propositional Logic

translationSources.label: 高等教育出版社 — 数学证明 通往高等数学的阶梯（第4版）影印版，官方中文目录
translationSources.locator: 官方中文目录：§2.3 析取与合取（名称证据，非正文定义证据）

definitionEn: In classical semantics, the connective reversing a statement’s truth value.
definitionZh: 在经典语义中把命题的真值反转的联结方式。
distinction: Constructively, ¬P means a derivation of falsity from P, not an automatic decision of P.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §2.4 The Language of Propositional Logic

translationSources.label: 高等教育出版社 — 数学证明 通往高等数学的阶梯（第4版）影印版，官方中文目录
translationSources.locator: 官方中文目录：§2.2 否定（名称证据，非正文定义证据）

definitionEn: A finite expression of a fixed first-order language built from atomic formulas using its permitted connectives and quantifiers.
definitionZh: 在固定一阶语言中，由原子公式按该语言的联结词和量词构成规则生成的有限表达式。
example: $\forall x\;(P(x)\to P(f(x)))$ is a formula if $P$ is unary and $f$ unary.
distinction: An expression with the wrong number of predicate arguments is not well formed.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §7.1 Functions, Predicates, and Relations (terms and formulas); §§7.2–7.3 (quantified formulas)

definitionSources.label: 杨睿之（复旦大学）— 数理逻辑，第11讲
definitionSources.locator: PDF pp.15–16「合式公式」：原子公式及联结词、量词的递归构成规则

translationSources.label: 杨睿之（复旦大学）— 数理逻辑，2021年秋季
translationSources.locator: PDF pp.15–16「合式公式」

definitionEn: An expression naming a domain value, built from variables, constants and correctly applied function symbols in a first-order language.
definitionZh: 一阶语言中由变元、常数符号和按元数正确使用的函数符号构成、用于指称论域元素的表达式。
example: $f(c)$ is a term when $f$ is unary and $c$ a constant.
distinction: Terms denote objects; formulas assert conditions and have truth values after interpretation.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §7.1 Functions, Predicates, and Relations, compound expressions called terms

definitionSources.label: 杨睿之（复旦大学）— 数理逻辑，第11讲
definitionSources.locator: PDF pp.13–14「项」：变元、常数及按元数应用函数符号的递归定义

translationSources.label: 杨睿之（复旦大学）— 数理逻辑，2021年秋季
translationSources.locator: PDF pp.13–14「项」

definitionEn: A first-order formula obtained by applying a relation symbol to terms, or by equating two terms when equality is present.
definitionZh: 由关系符号施用于适当个数的项，或在含等词时由两个项的等式形成的基本公式。
distinction: Atomic refers to syntactic construction; a complex term inside it does not make the formula non-atomic.

definitionSources.label: 杨睿之（复旦大学）— 数理逻辑，第11讲
definitionSources.locator: PDF p.15「原子公式」：关系符号作用于项及含等词时的项等式

translationSources.label: 杨睿之（复旦大学）— 数理逻辑，2021年秋季
translationSources.locator: PDF p.15「原子公式」

definitionEn: A nonempty domain equipped with interpretations of a first-order language’s constants, functions and relations of the prescribed arities.
definitionZh: 非空论域连同一阶语言中各常数、函数和关系符号的符合元数的解释。
example: $(\mathbb Z,0,+,<)$ interprets an ordered additive language.
distinction: A structure becomes a model of a theory only if it satisfies that theory’s sentences.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §10.2 Truth in a Model; §10.4 Validity and Logical Consequence; §10.5 Soundness and Completeness

translationSources.label: 杨睿之（复旦大学）— 数理逻辑，第14讲
translationSources.locator: PDF p.19「结构」

definitionEn: For a sentence set Γ, a sentence φ is a consequence when every structure satisfying Γ satisfies φ.
definitionZh: 对于语句集 Γ，若每个满足 Γ 的结构都满足 φ，则称 Γ 语义蕴含 φ。
distinction: ⊨ compares truth in structures; ⊢ asserts existence of a derivation.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §10.2 Truth in a Model; §10.4 Validity and Logical Consequence; §10.5 Soundness and Completeness

translationSources.label: 杨睿之（复旦大学）— 数理逻辑，第15讲
translationSources.locator: PDF p.6 定义「语义蕴含」；同页用「逻辑蕴涵」

definitionEn: A sentence is logically valid if every nonempty structure for its language satisfies it.
definitionZh: 语句在其语言的每个非空结构中都为真时称逻辑有效。
example: $\forall x\;(x=x)$ is valid in logic with equality.
distinction: Truth in the intended natural-number structure alone is not validity.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §10.2 Truth in a Model; §10.4 Validity and Logical Consequence; §10.5 Soundness and Completeness

translationSources.label: 杨睿之（复旦大学）— 数理逻辑，第15讲
translationSources.locator: PDF p.6：⊨α 与「逻辑有效」

definitionEn: A set of first-order sentences is satisfiable if one structure satisfies all of them together.
definitionZh: 存在一个结构同时满足全部语句时，该语句集称可满足。
example: $\{\exists x\,P(x),\exists x\,\neg P(x)\}$ has a two-element model.
distinction: Separate models for individual sentences need not give a simultaneous model for the set.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §10.2 Truth in a Model; §10.4 Validity and Logical Consequence; §10.5 Soundness and Completeness

translationSources.label: 杨睿之（复旦大学）— 数理逻辑，第17讲
translationSources.locator: PDF pp.21–22：「可满足」与紧致性定理

definitionEn: A sentence set is syntactically consistent in a specified classical calculus if no derivation from it concludes falsity.
definitionZh: 对于指定的经典演绎系统，若不能从一个语句集推出矛盾，则称它一致。
distinction: Consistency is relative to proof rules; satisfiability is semantic. Completeness connects them.

definitionSources.label: Jeremy Avigad — Logic and Computation (January 2002)

translationSources.label: 杨睿之（复旦大学）— 数理逻辑，第12讲
translationSources.locator: PDF p.17 定义「不一致」；第17讲 PDF pp.5–6 使用「一致」

definitionEn: For a sound complete classical first-order calculus, every semantic consequence of a sentence set has a finite derivation from it.
definitionZh: 对于可靠且完全的经典一阶演绎系统，语句集的每个语义后承都有从该集合出发的有限推演。
distinction: Completeness of the logic does not assert that an individual theory decides every sentence.

definitionSources.label: Jeremy Avigad — Logic and Computation (January 2002)

translationSources.label: 杨睿之（复旦大学）— 数理逻辑，第17讲
translationSources.locator: PDF p.5 定理「完全性定理」

definitionEn: A set of classical first-order sentences has a model if and only if every finite subset has a model.
definitionZh: 经典一阶语句集有模型，当且仅当其每个有限子集有模型。
example: The axioms $c>\bar n$ for all standard $n$, together with arithmetic, have a nonstandard model.
distinction: Finite fragments may use different models; the theorem does not force a model on a fixed domain.

definitionSources.label: Jeremy Avigad — Logic and Computation (January 2002)

translationSources.label: 杨睿之（复旦大学）— 数理逻辑，第17讲
translationSources.locator: PDF p.22 定理「紧致性定理」

definitionEn: The union of A and B contains exactly the objects belonging to at least one of them.
definitionZh: A 与 B 的并集恰由至少属于其中一个集合的对象组成。
distinction: Union discards duplicate members; tagged disjoint union retains which component supplied them.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §11.1 Elementary Set Theory; §11.4 Cartesian Product and Power Set

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第1章：「ZFC 公理一览」，并集公理及派生运算 X∪Y

definitionEn: The intersection of A and B contains exactly the objects belonging to both.
definitionZh: A 与 B 的交恰由同时属于二者的对象组成。
distinction: An empty indexed intersection needs an ambient universe; it is not an unrestricted universal set in ZF.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §11.1 Elementary Set Theory; §11.4 Cartesian Product and Power Set

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第1章：「ZFC 公理一览」，派生运算段「交 X∩Y」

definitionEn: The difference A∖B consists of members of A that do not belong to B.
definitionZh: 集合 A 与 B 的差由属于 A 而不属于 B 的元素组成。
distinction: Set difference is ordered: swapping A and B generally changes the result.

definitionSources.label: Avigad, Hua, Lewis and van Doorn — Logic and Proof
definitionSources.locator: §11.1 Elementary Set Theory; §11.4 Cartesian Product and Power Set

translationSources.label: 李文威 — 代数学方法，第一卷（作者源码）
translationSources.locator: 第1章：「ZFC 公理一览」，派生运算段「差」

definitionEn: For indexed sets, the set of pairs (i,x) with x in the i-th set, retaining the component index.
definitionZh: 一族带指标集合的无交并是所有 (i,x)（x 属于第 i 个集合）的集合，保留元素的来源指标。
distinction: Already disjoint subsets may use their ordinary union as a model; tagging handles overlapping inputs.

definitionEn: For specified sets A and B, an assignment giving each member of A exactly one member of B.
definitionZh: 对于指定的集合 A、B，为 A 的每个元素指定 B 中唯一一个元素的对应。
example: $n\mapsto n+2$ defines a map $\mathbb Z\to\mathbb Z$.
distinction: A formula alone does not specify a function until domain and codomain are stated.

definitionEn: A function $f:A\to B$ for which $f(x)=f(y)$ implies $x=y$ for all $x,y\in A$.
definitionZh: 对所有定义域元素 x、y，f(x)=f(y) 都推出 x=y 的映射。
distinction: Injectivity prohibits collisions; it does not require covering the codomain.

definitionZh: 像等于整个陪域 B 的映射 f:A→B。
distinction: Surjectivity can change when the codomain changes even if the formula and domain stay fixed.

definitionZh: 既单又满的映射；等价地，具有左右两侧逆映射的映射。
distinction: An inverse relation becomes an inverse function on the entire codomain only for a bijection.

definitionEn: For f:A→B and S⊆A, the set of values f(s) for s∈S.
definitionZh: 对于 f:A→B 和 S⊆A，所有 f(s)（s∈S）构成的集合。
distinction: Images preserve unions but need not preserve intersections when f is not injective.

distinction: Inverse-image notation does not assert that f has an inverse function.

definitionEn: For an equivalence relation on X, the class [x] consists of all elements related to x.
definitionZh: 对于 X 上的等价关系，x 的等价类 [x] 是所有与 x 等价的元素的集合。
distinction: A class is a set of representatives, rather than one preferred representative.

definitionEn: The set of equivalence classes of a specified equivalence relation on a set X.
definitionZh: 由指定集合 X 上某一等价关系的全部等价类组成的集合。
example: $\mathbb Z/{\sim}$ for congruence modulo four has four members.
distinction: Operations require compatibility with the relation before they descend to the quotient.

definitionEn: A reflexive, antisymmetric and transitive binary relation on a set.
definitionZh: 集合上满足反身性、反对称性和传递性的二元关系。
example: Inclusion orders $\mathcal P(\{2,5\})$; $\{2\}$ and $\{5\}$ are incomparable.
distinction: A partial order (偏序) is the relation; a partially ordered set or poset (偏序集) is the set equipped with that relation. Antisymmetry says mutual comparison forces equality; it is not the negation of symmetry.

definitionEn: A total order on a set in which every nonempty subset has a least element.
definitionZh: 一个全序，其中每个非空子集都有最小元素。
example: The usual order well-orders $\mathbb N$ but not $\mathbb Z$.
distinction: A least element of the whole set is insufficient; every nonempty subset must have one.

definitionEn: In ZFC, the least ordinal bijective with a set; equality of cardinalities is equivalently existence of a bijection.
definitionZh: 在 ZFC 中，与给定集合等势的最小序数；两个集合基数相等等价于它们之间存在双射。
distinction: Cardinal size ignores order; ordinal type remembers an ordering.

definitionZh: 集合 A 与 B 之间存在双射时成立的关系。
distinction: Equal cardinality does not require sets to be equal or nested.

definitionEn: A set that is finite or admits a bijection with the natural numbers, including the empty set.
definitionZh: 有限或与自然数集之间存在双射的集合；本条约定包括空集。
example: $\emptyset$, $\mathbb N$, and $\mathbb Z$ are countable; $\mathcal P(\mathbb N)$ is not.
distinction: Some Chinese and English texts use countable exclusively for the infinite case; this entry includes finite sets.

definitionEn: In ZFC, the assertion $2^{\aleph_0}=\aleph_1$, where $\aleph_1$ is the least uncountable cardinal.
definitionZh: 在 ZFC 中断言 2^ℵ₀=ℵ₁，其中 ℵ₁ 是最小不可数基数。
example: CH rules out a cardinal $\kappa$ with $\aleph_0<\kappa<|\mathbb R|$.
distinction: Cantor’s uncountability theorem is provable in ZFC; CH is independent if ZFC is consistent.
